_comment: llmops-sfn-execution -- the state machine's own role. It existed live from Phase 3 but
was declared NOWHERE in this repo: created by hand, never reconciled by 01_iam.py, and
listed in PROJECT_STATE.md as if 01_iam.py owned it. Undeclared infrastructure is a
role nobody can review and nobody can rebuild -- a fresh-account deploy would have
produced a pipeline whose state machine could not start.
The DynamoDB grant is what lets the state machine close out its own runs. Until it
existed, a stage Lambda that CRASHED (as opposed to escalating politely) left the run
at status=running forever, because every Python writer of that field lives inside the
Lambda that just died. Nine live runs were zombies this way.
UpdateItem only, on the runs table only. The state machine is not allowed to
create runs (that is start_pipeline's job) or delete them: its single write is
the terminal status of a run it is already executing.
